new_statements.rule_in_words: Yarshater states only that stress is not lexically contrastive; contrasts arise from morphology alone (stressed imperative/subjunctive bé- vs. unstressed preterite be- with stem-final stress: 'beše 'go!' vs be'še 'he went'). The default locus is not stated as a rule but every stress-marked nominal in the sketch is stem-final ([kɪl'lɪg] 'girl', [hou'lɪg] 'sister', [xæso'rɪg] 'wife's mother', [zæl'lɪk] 'boy', suka'la 'rooster', [ɪn'dʒɑ] 'here'), with the feminine ending -a and enclitic pronouns (-em) unstressed and demonstratives ['ɪm], ['ɪmæ] initially stressed; hence provisional reading: word/stem-final stress with morphologically governed exceptions (the usual Tati pattern). The 'fixed: final syllable' reading is an inference from the author's transcriptions plus p.279 n.2, not an explicit rule sentence.
new_statements.exceptions: Feminine direct-case ending -a unstressed (vs. stressed lexical -a in suka'la, xaso'ra); enclitic possessive -em unstressed ([zə'negəm] 'my knee'); demonstratives 'im, 'ima with initial stress; verb: imperative and present-subjunctive prefix b(e)- stressed ('stress is lost if the Subj. is used in a conditional sense', p.282 n.), present-indicative m(e)- and preterite/conditional b(e)- unstressed with stress on the last stem syllable; perfect = past participle with its final vowel stressed (àhar'de, bi'a nim) distinguishing it from the preterite.
new_statements.domain_note: Word-level (isolated words and short elicited sentences in the author's phonetic transcription); based on c. 8 hours with one 27-year-old speaker of Kajal village in 1958; author's caveat p.276 n.5: 'My conclusions are based on limited texts.. it is with due reservation that I present this grammatical sketch.'
new_statements.identity_note: Yarshater 1960 describes exactly the Glottolog languoid kaja1247: the Tati of Kajal village (Kaghaz-konan district, SW Khalkhal, then Persian Azarbaijan, now Ardabil province), also spoken in Aladin village by families from Kajal; one informant ('Abdur-Rahman Jabaruti, 27), c. 8 hours, summer 1958. Distinct from Shahrudi (Shal/Kulur) Khalkhal Tati = shah1254, which Yarshater 1959 describes separately.
